facts.text: The Lana is located at Marasi Drive in Business Bay, Dubai.
facts.excerpt: Our luxury hotel is located at Marasi Drive, Business Bay, Dubai.

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Burj Khalifa and is near Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall.
facts.excerpt: Yes, our five-star hotel overlooks the Burj Khalifa. It's also near Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall.

facts.text: The hotel is approximately 20 minutes' drive from Dubai International Airport.
facts.excerpt: We're approximately 20 minutes' drive from Dubai International Airport.

facts.text: The rooms and suites were designed by Gilles & Boissier, combining traditional elements with contemporary touches inspired by Dubai.
facts.excerpt: designers Gilles & Boissier elegantly combine traditional elements with contemporary touches, all inspired by the bold spirit of Dubai

facts.text: The Lana opened in 2024.
facts.excerpt: Since opening in 2024, The Lana

facts.text: The Lana is part of Dorchester Collection and is the brand's new chapter in the Middle East.
facts.excerpt: As part of Dorchester Collection’s portfolio of legendary hotels, it carries forward a legacy of excellence while shaping a new chapter for the brand in the Middle East.

facts.text: All suites have private balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: All of our suites have private balconies, floor-to-ceiling windows, and cinematic, soaring views.

facts.text: The Panoramic Suite has views of Marasi Bay Marina, Downtown Dubai and the Burj Khalifa.
facts.excerpt: Views of Marasi Bay Marina, Downtown Dubai and the Burj Khalifa

facts.text: The hotel has Dior Spa The Lana with a gym, and an infinity pool on the rooftop.
facts.excerpt: We have Dior Spa The Lana with a gym, an infinity pool on the rooftop

facts.text: Dior Spa The Lana is the only Dior Spa in Dubai and the first Dior Spa in the Middle East.
facts.excerpt: Yes, our spa is the only Dior Spa in Dubai. It's also the first Dior Spa in the Middle East.

facts.text: Spa treatments draw inspiration from the Dior Prestige range.
facts.excerpt: Our treatments draw exclusive inspiration from the Dior Prestige range

facts.text: The spa offers a Japanese-inspired massage ritual combining kneading, friction and percussive movements.
facts.excerpt: this unique, Japanese-inspired ritual. Combining kneading, friction and percussive movements

facts.text: The spa offers same-gender services only.
facts.excerpt: For your comfort, we offer same-gender services only.

facts.text: The gym is exclusively for in-house guests.
facts.excerpt: Our gym is exclusively for in-house guests

facts.text: Riviera by Jean Imbert is the chef's first restaurant in the Middle East.
facts.excerpt: Experience Jean Imbert’s first restaurant in the Middle East

facts.text: Riviera overlooks Marasi Bay Marina and serves modern Mediterranean cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the sparkling waters of Marasi Bay Marina, expect modern Mediterranean cuisine inspired by Jean's own experiences.

facts.text: Riviera's private dining room has a skylight that reveals blue skies or the stars above.
facts.excerpt: under a striking skylight that reveals blue skies or the stars above

facts.text: High Society sits at the very top of The Lana, with small plates, cocktails, live music and panoramic views over the Burj Khalifa.
facts.excerpt: At the very top of The Lana, High Society blends skyline glamour with curated rhythm. Small plates pair with crafted cocktails, live music and panoramic views over the Burj Khalifa.

facts.text: Martín Berasategui was the first chef to open a Basque restaurant in Dubai, Jara.
facts.excerpt: As the first chef to open a Basque restaurant in Dubai

facts.text: Jara serves seafood and charcoal-grilled steaks prepared in an open kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Beautiful seafood and charcoal-grilled steaks are prepared in the lively open kitchen

facts.text: Bonbon Café is pastry chef Angelo Musa's French patisserie beside the marina.
facts.excerpt: Award-winning pastry chef Angelo Musa brings the beauty of French patisserie to Dubai in this elegant café beside the marina.

facts.text: The Gallery is the hotel's social lounge and serves afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: The Gallery is the hotel’s social lounge, home to refined menus, our much-loved afternoon tea

facts.text: Bitter Honey is a cocktail bar with a tableside trolley service where cocktails are made to the guest's liking.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy an interactive experience courtesy of our exceptional tableside trolley service, where cocktails are made just to your liking

facts.text: Bitter Honey mixes its own homemade syrups.
facts.excerpt: First, we mix our own homemade syrups

facts.text: Txakolina is a cigar lounge with more than 45 cigars from Cuba, the Dominican Republic, Nicaragua and Honduras.
facts.excerpt: Txakolina is our exclusive cigar lounge. Here, you'll find more than 45 cigars from Cuba to the Dominican Republic, Nicaragua and Honduras

facts.text: At Txakolina, guests can age their chosen cigars with a favourite spirit.
facts.excerpt: we invite you to age your preferred cigars with a favourite spirit

facts.text: Veranda is a garden restaurant set against city views.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to Veranda, our garden restaurant set against soaring city views.

facts.text: Veranda closes for the summer season, Jara closes in August, and the outdoor terraces at Jara and Riviera close for the summer months.
facts.excerpt: Yes. Veranda closes annually for the summer season (June to October). Jara closes in August, and the outdoor terraces at Jara and Riviera also close for the summer months.

facts.text: Children must be accompanied by a parent in the pool until age 16, and after 5pm only adults aged 21 or above may use the pool.
facts.excerpt: Children must be accompanied by a parent until the age of 16. After 5pm, only adults aged 21 or above are allowed in the pool.

facts.text: An extra bed or cot for children and infants is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: For children and infants, an extra bed or cot is complimentary.

facts.text: Parking is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Parking is complimentary.

facts.text: There are no electric vehicle charging ports at the hotel; the closest are at Dubai Mall.
facts.excerpt: there are no electric vehicle charging ports at The Lana; the closest charging points are at Dubai Mall

facts.text: Pets are not allowed, except service dogs, for which there is no fee.
facts.excerpt: No pets are allowed unless they are service dogs, for which there is no fee.

facts.text: Non-resident guests can use the pool with a pool day pass, which requires pre-booking.
facts.excerpt: non-resident guests can access the pool with a pool day pass at (AED 300 per person). Pre-booking and full prepayment are required.

facts.text: The Lana Promenade beside Marasi Bay Marina offers further dining options alongside the hotel's own restaurants.
facts.excerpt: Set by the sparkling waters of Marasi Bay Marina, a world of extraordinary dining awaits: alongside The Lana's own exquisite restaurants, bars and patisserie, an array of remarkable dining options are ready to be savoured.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a new icon of contemporary elegance.
facts.excerpt: The Lana has stood as a new icon of contemporary elegance
